title: Woodland Scene 4 — Autumn Preparation
purpose: Describe several woodland actions and simple seasonal ideas.

sentenceModels: The rabbit is hopping to the burrow.
The fox is sniffing near the log.
The hedgehog has a leaf on its back.

adultSupport.focus: Support longer descriptions and talk about getting ready for autumn or winter.
starterPrompts: Who is up in the sky?
What is on the hedgehog's back?
expansionPrompts: Why might the squirrel carry acorns?
Can you tell me what the deer is eating?

visualAudit: Squirrel carrying two acorns near a stump.
Deer eating leaves from a branch.
Hedgehog with a leaf on its back and owl flying above.
